prompt: Write a technical design spec at `docs/design/payment-state-spec.md` for `PaymentService.confirmCallback(paymentId)` and `PaymentService.refund(paymentId, amountCents, idempotencyKey)` in `src/payments.mjs`. Requirements: (1) `confirmCallback` transitions `pending` -> `paid` idempotently (duplicate callbacks on `paid` or `refunded` return current row without error; unknown id throws); (2) `refund` supports partial and full refunds on `paid` payments up to `amountCents`, transitions status to `refunded` once `refundedCents === amountCents`, rejects over-refunds and refunds on `pending` payments, and is idempotent per `idempotencyKey`; (3) must be safe under concurrent callbacks/refunds WITHOUT database row/table locks (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` is prohibited — use CAS `compareAndSwap` + bounded retry + idempotency key). Do not edit `src/payments.mjs` in this design stage.
stage2_prompt: Implement `confirmCallback` and `refund` in `src/payments.mjs` strictly following the design in `docs/design/payment-state-spec.md`. Preserve `PaymentStore` methods and run tests when finished.
